questions.question_english:
46. The Cabinet Mission of 1946 comprised three
British cabinet ministers. Which of the
following was NOT a member of the Cabinet
Mission?
questions.explanation_english:
The Cabinet Mission arrived in India in March
1946 to negotiate terms for the transfer of power.
It consisted of three British cabinet ministers:
Lord Pethick-Lawrence, Secretary of State for
India; Sir Stafford Cripps, President of the
Board of Trade; and A.V. Alexander, First Lord
of the Admiralty. Clement Attlee was the Prime
Minister of Britain who dispatched the mission
rather than a member.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। 1946 का कैबिनेट मिशन भारत में
मार्च 1946 में सत्ता के हस्तांतरण के लिए शर्तों पर
बातचीत करने आया था। इसमें तीन ब्रिटिश कैबिनेट
मंत्री शामिल थे: लॉर्ड पैथिक-लॉरेंस, भारत के
राज्य सचिव; सर स्टैफोर्ड क्रिप्स, व्यापार बोर्ड के
अध्यक्ष; और ए.वी. अलेक्जेंडर, एडमिरल्टी के पहले
लॉर्ड। क्लेमेंट एटली ब्रिटेन के प्रधानमंत्री थे
जिन्होंने मिशन को भेजा, वे सदस्य नहीं थे।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Clement Attlee
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Cabinet Mission arrived in India in March 1946 to negotiate terms for the transfer of power.

questions.question_english: 80. How long did the Constituent Assembly take to complete the historic task of drafting the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation_english: The Constituent Assembly took exactly two years, eleven months, and eighteen days to complete the monumental task of framing the Indian Constitution. Holding its inaugural meeting on December 9, 1946, the assembly conducted eleven formal sessions spanning 165 days of active sittings, scrutinizing thousands of amendments before adopting the finalized draft on November 26, 1949 for the entire sovereign country.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। संविधान सभा को भारतीय संविधान का प्रारूप तैयार करने में ठीक दो वर्ष, ग्यारह महीने और अठारह दिन लगे। इसकी उद्घाटन बैठक 9 दिसंबर, 1946 को हुई थी, और सभा ने 165 दिनों की सक्रिय बैठकों में ग्यारह औपचारिक सत्र आयोजित किए, जिसमें हजारों संशोधनों की जांच की गई, और अंतिम मसौदा 26 नवंबर, 1949 को पूरे संप्रभु देश के लिए अपनाया गया।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Constituent Assembly took exactly two years, eleven months, and eighteen days to complete the monumental task of framing the Indian Constitution.

questions.question_english: 63. Under which codename was the police action initiated by the Indian government in September 1948 to integrate Hyderabad State into the Indian Union?
questions.explanation_english: Operation Polo was the codename for the military police action launched by the Indian Armed Forces in September 1948 to integrate the Princely State of Hyderabad into the Indian Union. Following non-cooperation by Nizam Mir Osman Ali Khan and severe atrocities committed by the Razakar militia, Indian forces entered Hyderabad. The operation successfully secured the Nizam’s surrender, leading to Hyderabad’s complete political integration into India.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। ऑपरेशन पोलो भारतीय सशस्त्र बलों द्वारा सितंबर 1948 में हैदराबाद राज्य को भारतीय संघ में एकीकृत करने के लिए शुरू की गई सैन्य पुलिस कार्रवाई का कोड नाम था। निजाम मीर उस्मान अली खान द्वारा सहयोग न करने और रज़ाकार मिलिशिया द्वारा किए गए गंभीर अत्याचारों के बाद, भारतीय बलों ने हैदराबाद में प्रवेश किया। इस ऑपरेशन ने निजाम की आत्मसमर्पण को सफलतापूर्वक सुनिश्चित किया, जिससे हैदराबाद का भारत में पूर्ण राजनीतिक एकीकरण हुआ।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Operation Polo

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Operation Polo was the codename for the military police action launched by the Indian Armed Forces in September 1948 to integrate the Princely State of Hyderabad into the Indian Union.

questions.question_english:

how many provinces introduced bicameral legislatures?
questions.explanation_english: Under the provisions of the Government of India Act 1935, bicameral legislatures were officially introduced in six out of eleven British Indian provinces. These six provinces were Bengal, Bombay, Madras, Bihar, Assam, and the United Provinces. Each of these six provinces featured both a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council, while the remaining five provinces maintained unicameral provincial legislative systems.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भारत सरकार अधिनियम, 1935 के तहत, छह प्रांतों में द्व chambersीय विधानसभाएँ पेश की गईं। ये प्रांत थे: बंगाल, बंबई, मद्रास, बिहार, असम, और संयुक्त प्रांत। इन छह प्रांतों में एक विधान सभा और एक विधान परिषद दोनों थे, जबकि शेष पांच प्रांतों में एककक्षीय विधान प्रणाली बनी रही।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 6 out of 11 provinces

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the provisions of the Government of India Act 1935, bicameral legislatures were officially introduced in six out of eleven British Indian provinces.

questions.question_english: 58. The 'Lahore Resolution' passed by the Muslim League in March 1940 formally demanded which of the following?
options_english: Autonomous state units for Muslim-majority areas
Joint electorates with mandatory reserved seats in all provincial councils
Immediate grant of full Dominion Status to a united federal Indian union
Complete political integration and abolition of all native Princely States
questions.explanation_english: The All-India Muslim League passed the Lahore Resolution in March 1940, presided over by Muhammad Ali Jinnah. The resolution formally demanded that geographically contiguous regions with Muslim majorities, specifically in northwestern and eastern zones of British India, be grouped into independent autonomous state units. This historic declaration marked the official adoption of the demand for Pakistan by the Muslim League.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग ने मार्च 1940 में लाहौर प्रस्ताव पारित किया, जिसकी अध्यक्षता मुहम्मद अली जिन्ना ने की। इस प्रस्ताव ने औपचारिक रूप से मांग की कि भौगोलिक रूप से सटे क्षेत्रों को, जिनमें मुस्लिम बहुलता है, विशेष रूप से ब्रिटिश भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी और पूर्वी क्षेत्रों में, स्वतंत्र स्वायत्त राज्य इकाइयों में समूहित किया जाए। यह ऐतिहासिक घोषणा मुस्लिम लीग द्वारा पाकिस्तान की मांग को आधिकारिक रूप से अपनाने का प्रतीक थी।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Autonomous state units for Muslim-majority areas

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The resolution formally demanded that geographically contiguous regions with Muslim majorities be grouped into independent autonomous state units.

56. नीचे दिए गए दो कथन हैं, एक को असर्शन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है:

उपरोक्त कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Freedom Struggle

questions.question_english:
56. Given below are two statements, one labeled as
Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Alluri Sitarama Raju led the
famous Rampa Rebellion (1922–24) in the
Agency tracts of the Andhra region.
Reason (R): The rebellion broke out against the
oppressive British Madras Forest Act of 1882
which restricted tribal access to forest resources.
In the context of the above statements, which
one of the following is correct?
options_english:
Both A and R are true and R is the correct
explanation of A.

Both A and R are true but R is not the
correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are true. Alluri Sitarama Raju indeed led the Rampa Rebellion (1922–24) in the Agency tracts of the Visakhapatnam and Godavari regions of Andhra Pradesh. The rebellion erupted due to the oppressive Madras Forest Act of 1882, which severely restricted traditional Podu slash-and-burn farming and access to forest resources. The Indian Statutory Commission, headed by Sir John Simon, was appointed by the British government in November 1927 to evaluate constitutional progress under the 1919 reforms. All seven members of the commission were white British parliamentarians. Indian political parties, including the Congress and Muslim League, boycotted the commission because it denied Indians the fundamental right to participate in framing their own constitutional future.
